_note: Each rule: lens, optional 'for' expansion, 'when' conditions (all must hold), polarity (+1 supportive, 0 descriptive, -1 strained), weight 1-3, a topic (chapter), and text. Receipts are produced by the conditions themselves, so every sentence the reading speaks can be traced to a chart fact. Variables in {braces} are filled from the facts.

rules.beat: {lordN}, lord of bhava-{h} ({hName}), sits in bhava-{p} ({pName}): the {hTheme} agenda is given a workable seat.
{lordN}, lord of bhava-{h} ({hName}), sits in bhava-{p} ({pName}): the {hTheme} agenda is worked through {pTheme}. A classroom with real homework; with awareness it is workable.{softNote}
{lordN} lords the difficult bhava-{h} ({hName}) and sits in bhava-{p}: trouble-house lord in a trouble house, the classical setup for turning adversity into a resource ({vipName} pattern).{mixNote}
rules.clause: [{lordN} lords dusthana bhava-{h}] [seated in dusthana bhava-{p}] [{vipName} pattern]
rules.caveat: Strength is reduced when the same graha also lords a good house.

rules.beat: {aN} (lord of bhava-{ha}) and {bN} (lord of bhava-{hb}) share {signN}: a kendra-lord and a trikona-lord joined is the classical raja-yoga shape. It speaks through bhava-{p} ({pName}), so its fruit arrives in that theme.{seatNote}
rules.caveat: A yoga's fruit is limited by the dignity and house of the grahas that form it.

rules.beat: {gN} is {digLower} in {signN}: its significations have a strong footing wherever it sits (bhava-{p}).
{gN} is debilitated in {signN} (bhava-{p}): its significations are under strain and learned the hard way.
The strain on {gN} has a cancellation condition: {nbWhy}. The weakness is real but not the final word.
rules.caveat: Cancellation conditions vary by text; the ones that fire are named so they can be checked.
